definitions.full: H3551. kav or kavvah [ כַּוָּה Nö GGA 1884. 1019 ] noun feminine window ( כַּוְּתָא ᵑ7 , Syriac , compare Schulth Lex. 91 (below * ), hence Arabic , id. , as loan-word Frä 13 ); — plural absolute מְּתִיחָן וִּין כַּ Dan 6:11 (compare S-C J6 ).
definitions.rootNote: (Aramaic) from a root corresponding to 3854 in the sense of piercing;
